versions.changelog:
douyin-competitor-watch-guaikei v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Provides command-line tools to fetch public Douyin video, user, and comment data, and track trending topics.
- Supports natural language intent mapping for easier user interaction.
- Enforces strict API token management and error handling with no exposure of sensitive information.
- Limits data to public content; personal/private, download, and other short-video platforms are not supported.
- Outputs structured JSON, with clear parameter boundaries and compliance with Douyin data use policies.
